products.name: Enterprise RAG Platform on Azure (AI Search + Private Data) — Commercial
products.short_description: Ground AI on your own data — a secure Retrieval-Augmented Generation platform with Azure AI Search, chunking, and permission-trimmed retrieval.
products.description:
Ground AI on your own data — a secure Retrieval-Augmented Generation platform with Azure AI Search, chunking, and permission-trimmed retrieval.

A chatbot that hallucinates because it can't see your data is worthless; one that leaks data because it ignores permissions is dangerous. This solution builds an enterprise RAG platform: data ingestion and chunking, embeddings, an Azure AI Search index with hybrid + semantic ranking, permission-trimmed (security-filtered) retrieval, and an orchestration layer that grounds Azure OpenAI on your private content with citations.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run automation (Python, IaC & scripts).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Data ingestion, chunking, and embedding pipeline (as code)
  • Azure AI Search index — hybrid search + semantic ranking + vector
  • Permission-trimmed / security-filtered retrieval (respect source ACLs)
  • Orchestration (grounded prompts, citations, evaluation) via prompt flow
  • Evaluation harness (groundedness, relevance) and monitoring

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A RAG platform that answers from your data with citations — and never returns content a user isn't allowed to see.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 4 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • AIRAG-Discovery.py — read-only readiness check for an enterprise RAG deployment on Azure
    • AIRAG-Ingest.py — build the permission-trimmed index, then chunk + embed + load private data
    • AIRAG-Report.py — posture report for the Enterprise RAG Platform on Azure
    • AIRAG-Validate.py — validate the RAG platform, incl. the PERMISSION-TRIMMING negative test

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
